title: THE TEAMMATE ROW SHOWS HIS GUN AND HIS ROUNDS
why: His answer g-64 (10-25, Add ammo and gun): two players on one couch should see what the other holds. The st word now carries am (rounds in the magazine) and rs (the reserve as his own HUD shows it), the host relays both, and the teammate row gets a third line under the bars: the gun name on the left, rounds / reserve on the right. The row box grows from 36 to 48 high and the row step from 44 to 56. Nothing is shown for fists or while his hands are busy.
now: The teammate row under the bars shows his gun and his rounds and reserve. Watch the left column at 4K and with three or more teammates: the rows are taller now.

edits.replacement: ,hd:(G.handsT>0||p.hand)?1:0,xo:ascOut(p)?1:0,am:Math.max(0,p.ammo|0),rs:(isFinite(rsvShow(p))?Math.max(0,Math.round(rsvShow(p))):-1)};   // v28.xx (cw-partnergun): am, rounds in his magazine; rs, his reserve as his own HUD shows it (-1 is endless)
